task.selection_decision: Selected for a one-task pilot after verifying the official Jira creation timestamp precedes the target, the target's first parent equals the recorded parent, and the complete parent-to-target Git diff path set. Evaluation label is every changed path in the target patch, including CHANGES.txt; Ripple impact-set-files is separately recorded metadata and is not used as ground truth.
cleaning_decisions: Use original issue summary plus cleaned opening technical problem statement; omit quoted mail headers, contact addresses, and follow-up discussion.
Ground truth is exact Git diff path set from parent to target; do not substitute Ripple impact-set-files.
No target diff/body, commit message, changed paths, or post-target repository content is included in predictor input.
